response.justification: Bogdan is a versatile, experienced full-stack/systems developer with strong open-source and mentoring credentials, but he does not meet the core minimum qualifications for this role: the job requires 8 years of C++ programming and 5 years building large-scale infrastructure/distributed systems/compute platforms, whereas his career centers on TypeScript/Node.js, JavaScript, DLang, and web/mobile stacks with only brief, early-career C++ exposure (~6 months at National Instruments plus a student project). There is also no evidence of formal technical leadership managing cloud/DevOps engineers or owning large-scale cloud compute platform strategy.
strengths: Broad, deep engineering experience across web, mobile, embedded and systems domains
Demonstrated mentoring and community leadership via workshops, talks, and open-source projects
Strong software craftsmanship practices (TDD, CI/CD, trunk-based development) and architecture experience in various stacks
concerns: C++ experience is minimal (~6 months) versus the required 8 years
No demonstrated large-scale cloud compute platform or distributed systems leadership matching job scope
No clear track record of formal technical leadership managing/mentoring cloud or DevOps engineering teams

key_factors.factor: Lack of large-scale cloud/distributed infrastructure leadership
Strong general software craftsmanship and mentoring background
